summary: Verified both requested fixes on frontend. (1) Jelly Jukebox phone-landscape (844x390): rhythm-hud (progress bar + mode chip) sits in header strip at top=18px, bottom=48px — does NOT overlap .rhythm-lanes (top=60px). Mode chip renders inline beside the progress bar for A-minor song. Bell solfege labels are display:none, bell targets sit 6px above lanes bottom, lane-target dashed zone (y=304, h=70) wraps the bell. Fullscreen button repositioned to top-right (y=16) away from lane 8. (2) Desktop regression (1280x800): rhythm-hud is below the header (y=80), mode chip appears UNDER the progress bar (y=112), labels display:block, bells still at bottom-5. Tapping bells registers hits (score went 0→50 after a tap). (3) Guitar sustain (Jam Session desktop): instrumented AudioContext.createBufferSource — holding guitar-note-3 for 5s produces a buffer source with loop=true, loopStart=2.279, loopEnd=2.880, scheduled stop at currentTime+14.5s (MAX_HOLD_SEC + 0.5). On pointerup the stop is rescheduled to +0.15s (quick fade) — exactly matching makeVoice/release in GuitarInstrument.js. Chord Am hold yields 3 looped sources (power-chord) each with stopFromNow≈14.5s. Strings pointer-hold works. No page errors, no 'loopStart' / 'setValueAtTime' exceptions during any of the holds.

issues: Console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' when MISS popups stack in AnimatePresence — pre-existing, not related to this iteration's fixes but worth cleaning the key generation in FeedbackPopup/MISS animations.

Console warning: 'An empty string ("") was passed to the src attribute' — a child is being rendered with src="" (likely a frame before assets loaded). Non-blocking but should pass null/omit the element until the url is ready.

action_items: (Optional) Fix duplicate-key warning in MISS/feedback popups in RhythmGamePage.
(Optional) Avoid rendering in the guitar/instrument frames before the asset resolves.
critical_code_review_comments: GuitarInstrument.makeVoice correctly uses setValueAtTime with current gain value during release, so no scheduled-value exceptions when canceling the ramp. Verified via instrumentation.
RhythmGamePage.js is 992 lines — approaching the 'split into modules' guideline. Consider extracting the bell/lane renderer and HUD into subcomponents.
index.css media queries use `body:has(.rhythm-board)` which requires Safari 15.4+/Chromium 105+ — acceptable but worth noting for very old iPads.
The duplicate React key warning indicates `feedback` objects may share ids when fires overlap; use a monotonic counter rather than `Date.now()`.
seed_data_creation: Set localStorage['jma_player_name_skipped_v1']='1' to bypass the player-name prompt during Jam Session testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phone-landscape CSS block at /app/frontend/src/index.css line 906 governs Jelly Jukebox + Jam Session landscape layouts. The player-name prompt can appear with a delay even after dismissal — pre-seed localStorage key 'jma_player_name_skipped_v1'='1' before testing /#/free-play. Song tiles sometimes don't respond to Playwright .click(); use element.click() via JS evaluate (works reliably). To audit Web Audio behavior, patch AudioContext.prototype.createBufferSource via page.add_init_script before navigation and record sources + stop() args on window.__srcs.
rca_of_the_issue: Both reported bugs are fixed: (a) Progress bar overlap was resolved by positioning .rhythm-hud absolutely in the header strip (top=18, left=92, right=150) under the phone-landscape media query, plus moving fullscreen button to top. (b) Guitar cutoff after ~3s was caused by the buffer source stopping at sample end; now makeVoice analyzes the tail (analyzeLoop) and enables src.loop=true with loopStart/loopEnd on zero crossings, extending playback up to MAX_HOLD_SEC (14s) with vibrato ramping in after 0.9s. Release() cancels scheduled gain and stops the source 150ms later for a quick fade.
